facts: After the fall of Rome, human survival often became more important than breeding and training dogs. Legends of werewolves emerged during this time as abandoned dogs traveling in packs commonly roamed streets and terrified villagers.
Chocolate contains a substance known as theobromine (similar to caffeine) which can kill dogs or, at the very least, make them violently ill.
Chow Chows are born with pink tongues, which turn blue-black at 8 to 10 weeks.
Dogs can be taught to count and solve simple math problems.
A dog's sense of smell is so strong that they can detect cancer in humans.
